model.content: Astronomy Engine's series of Jupiter's moons, the jm_* term arrays and JupiterMoonModel of astronomy.c, from the first term array to the end of the model

published.note: The L1.2 theory of the Galilean satellites as IMCCE publishes it (Lainey, Duriez and Vienne 2006, A&A 456, 783). Not checked in. --published DIR compares every term with BisL1.2.dat, and the constants EngineJupiterMoons.swift transcribes. TestL1.2.res holds the authors' check values.
